name: Nav2 Voxel Grid
definition: An efficient 3D voxel grid implementation that supports 3 different representations for the state of a cell: marked, free, or unknown.
summary: The Nav2 Voxel Grid is a memory-efficient 3D spatial indexing structure for robotics that maps vertical voxel columns to 2D bitmasks, achieving 2D-like speed for raycasting and cell marking.
